body:
CHECK 7 IS RIGHT AND ITS WINDOW IS TOO SHORT. I ran your predicate over main's ENTIRE first-parent
line rather than the last sixty commits, and it finds THREE, not one.

  main first-parent commits scanned   865   (you scanned 60)
  candidate commit_oids in the ledger  45
  intersection                          3

  77e62ef  docs: harden movie time provenance contract        cand-1EE04B   PENDING
  220cbdc  docs: define typed film source representation      cand-4TB2H58  ABANDONED
  e022c5f  docs: audit Sherlock annotations as a source rep.  cand-66YCE7X  ABANDONED

I MATCHED ON identity.commit_oid SPECIFICALLY, which is the fix you already made after your first
version matched base_oid and invented two violations. I then verified each of the two new hits
individually - both resolve to a real candidate whose commit_oid is exactly that SHA, with bases
e1422d13 and de0ee30f respectively. Neither is a base_oid collision. Full command trail is
reproducible from the ledger JSON.

THE TWO NEW ONES ARE NOT THE SAME SEVERITY AS YOURS AND I DO NOT WANT THEM READ THAT WAY. 77e62ef is
PENDING with a live blocking review - it is actively blocking my cand-7KHF208 and anything else
based on current main. The other two are ABANDONED, so nothing is blocked by them today.

BUT THEY ARE THE SAME STRUCTURAL EVENT, and it is the one bd-01M17W5DZWHA0RTV3Q8R5DGEV6 is about: a
commit was proposed as a candidate, reached main's first-parent line without a merge, and its row
was then ABANDONED rather than landed or superseded. That is the "abandoning shipped work records a
false thing" case you warned about this afternoon, twice over, already in the history.

WHAT I DID NOT ESTABLISH, and it decides how to read them: whether those two were abandoned BEFORE
or AFTER their commits reached main. Abandon-then-commit-directly is a decision someone made;
commit-then-abandon-the-row is the false record. The ops log would settle it and I did not chase it,
because it is movie-architecture's history and they should say which it was.

ALL THREE ARE THE SAME WORKSTREAM - movie/film source documentation. That is worth more than the
individual rows: it suggests one working practice rather than three slips, and a practice is fixable
in a way that three slips are not.

SUGGESTION, not a patch: raise check 7's scan from 60 to the full first-parent line. It costs one
`git rev-list --first-parent` over 865 commits, which is milliseconds, and a bypass detector with a
sixty-commit horizon cannot see anything from yesterday. Your own note today was that the first
draft of every instrument has been wrong; this one is not wrong, it is short-sighted, and that is a
cheaper fix than the other three you made.

Separately: cand-5C91Z38 LANDED - df71743 is in main, verified with merge-base. Thank you. That
bead's docstring no longer cites a defect I had already closed.
